# neo4jaura_project_user (Resource)

Manages a user's membership in an Aura project.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `organization_id` (String) The ID of the organization that contains the project.
- `project_id` (String) The ID of the project the user is being registered in.
- `user_id` (String) The ID of the user to register in the project.

### Optional

- `deregister_on_delete` (Boolean) When `true`, the user is removed from the project on resource deletion. When `false` (default), the user's membership is left intact and only the Terraform state is removed.
- `project_roles` (List of String) The roles assigned to the user within the project. Possible values: `project-admin`, `project-member`, `project-viewer`, `project-metrics-integration-reader`.
